title: Abelmoschus manihot (L.) medik. seeds alleviate rheumatoid arthritis by modulating JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway.
authors: Tao, Yiwen; Liu, Jia; Li, Mengjia; Wang, Hongling; Fan, Gang; Xie, Xiaolong; Fu, Xing; Su, Jinsong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄蜀葵种子通过JAK2/STAT3通路缓解类风湿关节炎，仅涉及分子对接验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Abelmoschus manihot (L.) Medik. Seeds (AMS, སོ་མ་ར་ཛ།), a Tibetan classical herbal in China, are rich in flavonoids and phenolic glycosides compounds, such as quercetin and its derivatives. Moreover, it has been found to possess anti-rheumatoid arthritis (RA) effects. Nonetheless, its anti-RA mechanism is yet unknown. AIM OF THE STUDY: This research aimed to examine the active ingredients of AMS as well as potential pharmacological mechanisms in AMS on RA. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The ultra-performance liquid chromatography-electrospray ionization-tandem multistage mass spectrometry (UPLC-ESI-IT-MS(n)) technique was used to determine the primary chemical components of AMS that were responsible for the therapeutic effects on RA. In addition, 36 male Wistar rats weighing between 200 and 220 g were classified at random into six groups [normal control group, collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) group, methotrexate group (positive control, 1.05 mg/kg), AMS group (157.5 mg/kg, 315 mg/kg, 630 mg/kg)]. CIA rats were given AMS extract by intragastric administration for 28 days, and their ankles were photographed to observe the degree of swelling. Further, the arthritis score, paws swelling, and body weight changes of CIA rats were determined to observe whether AMS has any effect on RA, and synovial and cartilage tissue injuries were identified by histopathology. Besides, the levels of IL-10, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, INF-gamma, etc. in serum were estimated by ELISA. Western blot experiments were implemented to identify the expression levels of protein involved in the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway in the CIA rats' synovial tissues. Moreover, the mechanisms and targets of active ingredient therapy of AMS for RA were predicted using network pharmacology and then verified using molecular docking. RESULT: In the present study, 12 compounds were detected by UPLC-ESI-IT-MS(n), such as quercetin and its derivative which could be potential active ingredients that contribute to the anti-RA properties of AMS. Our in vivo studies on CIA rats revealed that an AMS-H dose of 630 mg/kg significantly improved joint damage while decreasing the arthritic index and paw swelling. Furthermore, AMS inhibited the INF-gamma, IL-6, IL-17, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha, levels while upregulating the expression of anti-inflammatory cytokines IL-10 and IL-4 in serum. Besides, AMS inhibited the protein Bcl-2/Bax, STAT3, and JAK2 levels, and promoted the expression of Caspase3, SOCS1, and SOCS3 in the JAK2/STAT3 pathway. Additionally, the JAK/STAT signaling pathway was found to perform a remarkable function in the AMS therapy of RA as evidenced by enrichment in GO terms and KEGG pathways. Meanwhile, data from molecular docking experiments indicated that the core targets of PIK3CA, JAK2, and SRC bound stably to the active ingredients of mimuone, 4'-methoxy-bavachromanol, and quercetin. CONCLUSION: According to these findings, the AMS could improve joint inflammation in CIA rats, and its underlying mechanism could be linked to the regulation of the JAK2/STAT3 pathway. Therefore, AMS might become a promising agent for alleviating inflammation in RA patients.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：黄蜀葵（Abelmoschus manihot (L.) Medik.）种子（AMS，སོ་མ་ར་ཛ།）是中国的一种藏族经典草药，富含黄酮类和酚苷类化合物，如槲皮素及其衍生物。此外，已发现其具有抗类风湿关节炎（RA）作用。然而，其抗RA机制尚不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在考察AMS的活性成分及其在RA中的潜在药理机制。材料与方法：采用超高效液相色谱-电喷雾电离-串联多级质谱（UPLC-ESI-IT-MS(n)）技术测定AMS中对RA治疗作用起主要作用的化学成分。此外，将36只体重在200至220克之间的雄性Wistar大鼠随机分为六组[正常对照组、胶原诱导关节炎（CIA）组、甲氨蝶呤组（阳性对照，1.05 mg/kg）、AMS组（157.5 mg/kg、315 mg/kg、630 mg/kg）]。通过灌胃给予CIA大鼠AMS提取物28天，并拍摄其踝关节以观察肿胀程度。进一步测定CIA大鼠的关节炎评分、爪肿胀和体重变化，以观察AMS是否对RA有影响，并通过组织病理学鉴定滑膜和软骨组织损伤。此外，采用ELISA法评估血清中IL-10、TNF-α、IL-1β、INF-γ等水平。通过Western blot实验检测CIA大鼠滑膜组织中JAK2/STAT3信号通路相关蛋白的表达水平。同时，利用网络药理学预测AMS活性成分治疗RA的机制和靶点，并通过分子对接进行验证。结果：在本研究中，通过UPLC-ESI-IT-MS(n)检测到12种化合物，如槲皮素及其衍生物，这些可能是AMS抗RA特性的潜在活性成分。我们对CIA大鼠的体内研究表明，630 mg/kg的AMS-H剂量显著改善了关节损伤，同时降低了关节炎指数和爪肿胀。此外，AMS抑制了INF-γ、IL-6、IL-17、IL-1β和TNF-α水平，同时上调了血清中抗炎细胞因子IL-10和IL-4的表达。另外，AMS抑制了JAK2/STAT3通路中Bcl-2/Bax、STAT3和JAK2蛋白水平，并促进了Caspase3、SOCS1和SOCS3的表达。此外，通过GO术语和KEGG通路富集分析，发现JAK/STAT信号通路在AMS治疗RA中发挥了显著作用。同时，分子对接实验数据表明，核心靶点PIK3CA、JAK2和SRC与活性成分mimuone、4'-甲氧基-巴伐色满醇和槲皮素稳定结合。结论：根据这些发现，AMS可以改善CIA大鼠的关节炎症，其潜在机制可能与调节JAK2/STAT3通路有关。因此，AMS可能成为缓解RA患者炎症的有前景的药物。
